type: Enrollment-discriminant native/decoded identity margin with original CTC constraints
validation_selection: Sorted original sentence indices 76:78, first ten enrolled speakers; exclude all prior observed, optimized, validation and enrollment sentences.
content_design: Two fixed optimization contents; four pre-existing evaluation contents, including both optimization-overlap and held-out text. Not all conversion contents are held out.
gradient_design: Shrinkage LDA fitted solely to native enrollment Es; equal class priors, centered means. Minimize smooth worst-case owner-vs-best-impostor score margin over reference and two decoded-mel re-encodings. Full-context CTC conflicts projected away; add CTC descent when above baseline. No Griffin-Lim or independent scorer gradient.
warm_start: Rerun the same fixed native baseline for each utterance; both refinements use its exact PCM16 export. All checkpoint acceptance uses training proxies, never final GE2E/MOSNet/Whisper scores.
primary_evaluation: Held-out GE2E + original MOSNet + Whisper small.en; MOS>=3/WER<=.10 frozen Basic normalizer. English-normalized WER diagnostic only.
secondary_evaluation: ECAPA/base retained but ECAPA participates in optimization and is explicitly non-independent.
selection_rule: One global challenger selected on development only: maximize full-clean Eq10 success count, strict identity joint count, unique protected-quality count, lower macro WER, higher protected MOS, profile name. Compare this tuple to baseline and retain baseline recommendation unless strictly better. Selected challenger still gets one frozen paired validation for an honest test.
reporting: Report clean-control coverage, complete joint endpoint, identity-only-screen endpoint, strict identity endpoint, raw counts, per-content/text strata, speaker-cluster paired intervals, and all failed candidates.
limitations: Development sentences already observed; fresh validation only if fixed development gate passes.
LDA/native/CTC/ECAPA training proxies may overfit; GE2E, MOSNet and both Whisper models remain held out.
One candidate relaxes the SNR and masking budget; that alone can change quality and defense.
Twenty fresh sentences from ten enrolled speakers, not unseen-pretraining people.
No human listening study, second VC model or paper-scale quality equivalence claim.
development_design: Twelve previously evaluated utterances from ten enrolled speakers, intentionally reused as development; no claim that these are untouched validation.
proxy_acceptance: Every 16 steps accept strictly improved training identity loss with CTC<=baseline+.01, original ECAPA cosine>=baseline-.005 and relative spectral distance<=baseline+.03. Reject/rollback and lower rate otherwise. Recheck actual PCM16 before independent evaluation; failure copies baseline.
content_supervision: Ground-truth reference text, uppercase letters/apostrophe/spaces normalized for torchaudio WAV2VEC2_ASR_BASE_960H. Frozen evaluation Basic normalization and WER<=10% remain unchanged. Full reference context retained for CTC.
validation_gate: Selected candidate must strictly improve development full-clean success count, not decrease strict success count or unique original-quality count, preserve every baseline-passing original, macro WER <= baseline+.005, and predicted MOS >= baseline-.05. Otherwise stop without scoring fresh validation.
source_note: New native discriminant extension, not an official Voice Guard or Kalypta implementation.

discriminant_fit.note: Training enrollment accuracy only, not independent generalization evidence.

relaxed_budget_note: The second profile permits SNR18 and +3dB masking allowance. It is a different perturbation budget and cannot establish same-distortion or inaudibility equivalence.
implementation_correction: Initial attempt interrupted during development after discovery that the reused projector rejects negative margins. Corrected allowance scales its positive amplitude cap instead. Initial protocol, source archive, partial WAVs, log and state retained. No initial validation was run; reserved validation sentences remain untouched.
